question: With which of the following Government of India Acts did the Montagu-Chelmsford Reforms introduce Dyarchy in the provinces?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Government of India Act, 1919.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Montagu-Chelmsford Reforms introduced Dyarchy in the provinces through the Government of India Act, of 1919.**
